notes_full: Based at the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre. 55+ organising for LGBTQ+ people of colour, all genders. Fills a critical gap — the only identified org serving older Black/POC queer people specifically. Directly addresses the documented absence of services for older Black queer people. — CORRECTED + ROUTED 6 Aug 2026 (Rob: "run out of London LGBTQ Community Centre"). Age is 50+, NOT 55+ — their own event name is "Melanin Vybz (BPOC 50+ Meetup)". Meets 3rd Friday monthly 17:30–19:30 IN PERSON at the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre, 60-62 Hopton Street, Bankside SE1 9JH, AND last Friday monthly 16:00–17:30 ONLINE — hybrid, which matters for this cohort. Contact route is the Centre: hello@londonlgbtqcentre.org. Also listed in the LGBT Consortium member directory; events on Eventbrite and londonlgbtqcentre.org. Previously filed by Claude as "no route found", which was wrong — the route was recorded in this very note.
